mechanism.checkpoint_chain: each signed checkpoint commits to the previous checkpoint SHA-256

supports: internally demonstrated signed integrity checkpoints for the SARA application audit prefix
detection of tested historical audit-content modification within the signed prefix
detection of tested historical record reordering within the signed prefix
detection of tested truncation below the signed record count
cryptographic rejection of altered signed checkpoint bundles and untrusted signing keys
explicit visibility of records newer than the latest checkpoint
rollback detection for the local checkpoint ledger when the expected latest checkpoint digest is retained separately
does_not_support: proof against compromise of the signing key or signer
proof of deletion of uncheckpointed tail records
proof against coordinated privileged rollback of both local audit and checkpoint ledger without an external latest-digest pin

next_gate.name: EXTERNAL_CHECKPOINT_ANCHOR_AND_OPERATOR_WORKFLOW
next_gate.goal: make the latest signed checkpoint digest independently retainable and verifiable outside the local SARA storage boundary, then expose create/verify/status as an operator-controlled workflow without weakening existing audit durability semantics
